chunks: From him, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"Do not eat with the left hand while you are able [to use the right]."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating with the left hand in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the etiquette of eating with the right hand as a recommended act (mustahabb) for those physically capable, linking bodily conduct to spiritual mindfulness. This practice is deeply rooted in Shia jurisprudence as a manifestation of following the Sunnah of the Prophet and the Imams, distinguishing it from obligatory acts while maintaining its significance in daily worship. The instruction emphasizes intentionality and gratitude, reflecting the broader Shia emphasis on integrating ritual purity and etiquette into mundane actions.
